pager.c:look_region_nearby1967-1975 returns clipped row-major bounds; existing js/pager.js/source-pinned test covers the asymmetric x/y lower bounds.

Existing self_lookat108-133, look_at_monster422-552 and look_at_object383-419 provide consumed output buffers. monhealthdescr is compile-time disabled and returns empty. Preserve existing naming/state dependencies; no copied description helper.

display.h:canspotself171-176 uses Blind/uswallow/(!Invisible&&!uundetected) or Unblind_telepat/Detect_monsters. Existing display.js private hero helper is separate; use the exact expression in pager without reserving the active display owner.

display.c glyph predicates/glyph_to_warning, map_glyphinfo plus tty_menu.js decoded glyphCells provide existing glyph classification/text output. Source look_all putmixed decodes the encoded glyph; use this substrate rather than remembered disp_ch.
pager.c:look_traps and look_engrs independently still refuse alternate coordinates. They are outside this whole look_all scope; preserve a representative blocked recipe. No do_look completion credit.

evidence: Assigned-base .cache/B176/scan.json/log reproduces18/32screens and first stop segment0step18 keym, no earlier divergence; saved evaluation has2322/2322RNG and18/32cursors. C header is Monsters currently shown near (here):.

Complete pager.c:look_all1979-2074 scans y-major/x-minor, counts monster/self/invisible/warning or object rows, uses source constants for warning/invisible text, emits the header on count1, then coordinate prefix and encoded glyph. Source calls display_nhwindow(TRUE) if count, otherwise pline, then destroys the window.

Current JS look_all827-884 only accepts NONE/MAP, hardcodes map header/alignment, treats any hero glyph as visible self, omits invisible/warning rows and uses remembered display character. All are branches of the same selected function rather than new source owners.

C coordinate widths are raw SCREEN, MAP right-aligned8 with single-digit-y trailing space, compass/full-compass right-aligned12. COMPASS nearby header is you/your position; COMFULL header is coord_desc(hero)=(here). Source lookbuf capacity accounts for encoded glyph length before decode.

Existing getpos-cycle.test.mjs136 pins every pure mode. Add explicit-mode override test and source-derived alignment/header/glyph-row tests, plus independent C-first nearby/all monster/object variations. Admitted range18-31 supplies the full-compass nearby-monster entry. Future runtime blockers must remain named, with no broader pager/getpos completion claim.
